body:
I think its been a relatively short time since Ive been smoking marijuana, but I know in the short time I have, Ive learnt and experienced a hell of a lot of things. One thing that Ive experienced is the complete shift of reality, and the amazing, enlightening realization that reality is so much more intangible then I couldve ever imagined,
my whole perception of reality being completely shattered and turned on its head. Weed changed me, but I believe this experience was a positive impact on my life.
Weed changed me, but I believe this experience was a positive impact on my life.
I dont think I could even begin to describe the best experience Ive had on weed, maybe even the best experience Ive had in my life. This experience is one Id never forget, and is truly a priceless memory.
Me and some friends accumulated a kind of weed smoking group. We would all meet up around once or twice a week, and get high together on a hill. Usually it was great, wed all laugh, and Id get the giggles like mad. This time however we had something new with us, a bright, florescent orange, handheld bong.
Rather than being on a hill, we were at one of my friends houses. She had a large tent like thing in her garden, which is where we decided to blaze on our new bong. We all shared a round, except for one of us, E who preferred spliffs. After the round was out, which was relatively soon, we each decided to go to the kitchen. I wasnt feeling very high, and was generally disappointed. The weed we had was something called AK, supposedly strong.
When I got into the kitchen, and literally as I stepped through the door, the weed hit me. Whilst mild, it still hit me, and I began to feel strange and relaxed. E didnt feel anything at all, so started prepping another spliff in the kitchen. Another one of my friends J suddenly went insanely high. She took a cooking timer, and started dancing to the rhythm of it ringing. J seemed to get increasingly fucked off her head as she danced to this crazed ringing sound, which eventually started to make me feel a little higher, as I found myself laughing at something so completely retarded.
I felt I needed more weed to fully appreciate Js comedy performance, so I prepped up the bong. No one else felt like having more, so I had a whole round to myself. At the time it never crossed my mind, but I was just about to smoke more weed than Id ever smoked before, I was about to get more high than Ive ever been before, and to this day have never been.
After the first pull of this round, I started feeling insanely fucked, by the end; I had smoked myself into an ethereal state of mind. Ive always found my appreciation of music goes through the skies when Im high, but never before has anything like what happened to me even crossed my mind as possible on marijuana. Many people see weed as a mild alternative to other drugs, but Ill tell you now, marijuana is no mild drug when taken in extremely high dosage.
I sat back in the chair, listening to a song called Heroine by Sayonara. I felt like the whole chair was a cushion, some kind of liquid cushion that wrapped around me, and was as malleable as melted plastic. As the song started I experienced, whilst not vivid, closed eye hallucinations. What I saw had a direct effect on the way my body felt. This was the most extreme body high Id ever felt in my life, this whole experience Im about to describe was nothing short of 15-20 minutes of pure euphoria.
When I closed my eyes, I first saw colours, similar to what Id see when I'm sober, though they moved in a different way, more rhythmically. The colours were more intense and lucid.
As the song started to get more intense, as did my hallucinations. I began to see the colours form into images, like a field, a sunset, etc... As I put my head back, thats when the strange stuff really started to happen.
I began to see the colours form into images, like a field, a sunset, etc... As I put my head back, thats when the strange stuff really started to happen.
My hallucinations became more and more vivid, although they werent vivid enough to be comparable to an LSD trip for example; they were still pretty vivid for Cannabis though. I started to see as if I were looking through a kaleidoscope, diamonds and shapes forming what looked like the inside of a kaleidoscope. I slowly felt like I was fading away from my body, I then felt for a few seconds that I was completely exempt from my body, and in those seconds I lost all concept of being alive and being human in a bodily form. I felt like a spirit, like I had left my body and became consciousness of the purest and most divine form. This feeling of being exempt from my body was accompanied by a surge of intense pleasure all over my body, pleasure so intense, and euphoric, it made my whole body move in tremors as it flowed everywhere.
This pleasure wasnt at all sexual, but it was something greater, something beyond the mere animalistic sexuality we all know. It didnt involve anyone, it was just me and my mind, my penis wasnt erect, so I wasnt sexually stimulated, I have no idea what this was, but it was by far the best experience of my life, and one, no matter how much weed I smoked, I wasnt able to achieve again. I coined this as Having sex with my mind.
As I opened my eyes, J turned round to me and said did you just have a massive orgasm, to which I replied No, I just had sex with my mind. She didnt really understand what I meant and to this day no other stoner has either. The rest of the day was pretty bland in comparison to the experience.
